about: By hand: the BWB treaty of each Protocol to the European Convention on Human Rights that HUDOC names by number in the articles of a judgment (`P1-1` is article 1 of Protocol 1). HUDOC gives the number, the BWB the treaty, its title and where and when it was signed (WTI `plaats`, `datum`); no source joins the two. Only the Protocols that hold rights: the others (11, 14, 15, 16) change the procedure of the Court. `lawgraph curated set echr-protocols`.
